content.value_statement: QMS audits require consistent planning, evidence review, and defensible nonconformity documentation. This skill guides ISO 13485 audit programs, audit execution, CAPA follow-up, and external audit preparation.
actual_capabilities: Guides risk-based internal audit planning for ISO 13485 clause 8.2.2.
Structures audit preparation, evidence collection, reporting, and closing activities.
Helps classify major nonconformities, minor nonconformities, observations, and best practices.
Connects audit findings to CAPA initiation, root cause support, and effectiveness verification.
Outlines preparation for regulatory inspections, certification audits, and customer audits.
Defines auditor competency requirements and audit program performance metrics.
limitations: Does not replace an accredited auditor, certification body, or regulatory counsel.
Supporting files are placeholders; referenced guides and automation scripts are not implemented in this package.
Does not access live QMS records, document systems, or regulatory databases unless the user provides data.
Requires organization-specific procedures, product risk data, and audit history for final audit decisions.

use_cases.title: Build an annual audit program
use_cases.description: Create a risk-based internal audit schedule that reflects process criticality, past findings, and QMS performance data.

use_cases.title: Prepare for an external audit
use_cases.description: Organize readiness checks, roles, evidence requests, and response planning before a regulatory or certification audit.

use_cases.title: Turn findings into CAPA actions
use_cases.description: Classify audit findings, document objective evidence, and plan corrective action verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create an audit plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a risk-based ISO 13485 internal audit plan for these processes: [process list]. Include scope, criteria, frequency, and audit priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an audit checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an audit checklist for [process name] using ISO 13485 requirements. Include evidence to request, interview topics, and sample objective evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Classify audit findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these audit observations and classify each as major nonconformity, minor nonconformity, observation, or best practice. Explain the rationale and CAPA need.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate audit program effectiveness
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these audit metrics, finding trends, CAPA recurrence data, and stakeholder feedback. Recommend changes to the audit program and auditor competency plan.

output_examples.input: A quality manager provides process risk levels, recent complaint trends, and last year audit findings.
output: A prioritized annual audit schedule with quarterly, annual, and event-driven audit recommendations.
Scope notes for high-risk processes and suggested auditor competency needs.
Follow-up items for recurring findings and CAPA effectiveness checks.

output_examples.input: An audit team shares observations from a production process audit.
output: A finding classification summary with major, minor, observation, and best practice categories.
Objective evidence wording that links each finding to a requirement and observed condition.
Recommended CAPA initiation and verification steps.

output_examples.input: A regulatory affairs lead asks for external audit readiness support.
output: A readiness checklist covering roles, evidence rooms, document control, and response escalation.
A meeting plan for opening, daily debrief, and closing discussions.
A list of unresolved readiness risks to address before the audit date.

best_practices: Provide current procedures, audit history, complaint trends, and process risk ratings before asking for audit plans.
Tie every finding to objective evidence, requirement references, and the observed condition.
Verify CAPA implementation and effectiveness before closing audit follow-up actions.
anti_patterns: Treating checklist completion as proof of QMS effectiveness without evidence review.
Classifying findings before confirming the requirement, condition, and objective evidence.
Using generic audit findings that do not identify the affected process or requirement.

faq.question: Is this skill only for ISO 13485?
faq.answer: It focuses on ISO 13485 and medical device QMS auditing. Some audit planning practices can support other regulated quality systems.

faq.question: Does it replace a qualified auditor?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning, documentation, and review, but qualified personnel remain responsible for audit judgments.

faq.question: Can it help with regulatory inspections?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure readiness checks, evidence organization, roles, and response planning for external audits.

faq.question: Can it classify nonconformities?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help compare observations to requirements and suggest major, minor, observation, or best practice categories.

faq.question: Does it access my QMS records automatically?
faq.answer: No. Provide relevant procedures, records, metrics, and findings for the skill to analyze them.

faq.question: Are the referenced scripts fully implemented?
faq.answer: No. The included supporting files are placeholders, so automation should be added before relying on script workflows.
